transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'm Lena, and as most of you know, I'm considering an informal exchange of my first-pressing vinyl record. Marcus has mentioned a possible trade involving a used synthesizer, but we haven't settled on any terms yet. Before I agree to anything, my usual practice is to hear from each person present — so if anyone has a relevant offer, comparison, compatibility note, or handoff detail, now's the time to put it on the table. And if anyone is bringing up an offer from someone who isn't here today, I'll record that as your report. So, who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is my Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer plus $75 in cash for Lena's first-pressing vinyl record, with the exchange on Saturday at 2:00 p.m.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should put this on the table since Lena asked for any relevant offers. Gabe — another collector who isn't here today — told me privately that he'd pay exactly $400 cash for the record and could collect it Sunday afternoon. I'm reporting this as his offer since he's not present to speak for himself.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a compatibility and handoff detail to add. I personally tested Marcus's synthesizer and confirmed it's a 110-volt unit, so it must be used with a step-down transformer. Marcus does have one available to include in the exchange.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Thank you all for putting your information on the table. Let me summarize what I've heard so far: Marcus, your proposal is the Korg Minilogue XD plus $75 cash, with exchange on Saturday at 2:00 p.m. Iris, you're reporting that Gabe — who isn't here — would pay $400 cash and collect Sunday afternoon; I'll record that as your report of his offer. Dev, you've confirmed the synthesizer is a 110-volt unit needing a step-down transformer, and that Marcus has one available to include. I have no private information of my own to add. Let me take a moment to consider everything before I make my final decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Of course, Lena, take your time. I'd just like to add that I'm happy to include the step-down transformer Dev mentioned as part of my proposal — it comes with the synthesizer at no extra cost. The Saturday 2:00 p.m. handoff works well for me, and I'm flexible if you need to adjust the time. I'll leave it in your hands.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Marcus. I think everything's on the table from my side — Gabe's offer as I reported it is all I had to contribute. Lena, I'll leave it to you to weigh the options.
transcript.speaker: A3
